eligibility: Published nonempty messages, non-null numeric reward, terminal reason other than infrastructure_error. Preserve integrity failures as flags, never silently replace selected records.
unit: Independent task ID; choose smallest available trial then source index among eligible runs; one run per task. This privileges earliest completed trial and is a documented bias.
random_base: Sort eligible task IDs lexicographically; random.Random(20261020).sample(pool,min(30,len(pool))); do not stratify or replace by outcome or interest.
targeted: From remaining independent tasks, apply the following five observable strata in fixed order, up to 4 per stratum. For each take up to 2 reward=1 then up to 2 reward=0, ordered by SHA256(seed|stratum|task_id). No quota backfill and no replacements. At most 20.

target_strata.predicate: assistant tool name contains transfer OR at least 2 distinct non-information assistant tool names
tool error field true/nonempty OR tool content starts Error (case-insensitive), either actor; retain actor attribution
assistant tool name contains unlock_discoverable OR call_discoverable
at least 3 non-information assistant tool calls
at least 6 assistant tool calls of KB_search*, shell, get_*, list_*, find_*, search_*

information_proxy: KB_search*, shell, get_*, list_*, find_*, search_* names; shell may contain writes, so this is only a candidate detector, not true information value.
interpretation: Mechanical retrieval cues, not failure taxonomy or causal labels. Targeted outcome balancing is disclosed and never changes the base random sample.
stop: No additional task sampling after this single deterministic draw; no paid API, agent execution, training or benchmark modification. Supplement limited to one independently sourced complete trace.
